scope: Day 10 one-document indexing and traceable exact retrieval; local explicit entry points

dependency_change.reason: Maintainer-provided vector(768) serialization and SQLAlchemy cosine operators; validated against real PostgreSQL before adoption

service_independent_checks.skip_reason: Real PostgreSQL/Redis/worker/container checks disabled explicitly; they were executed in the full real-dependency run

migration_command.metadata_reader: migration role; runtime role remains denied

tests.warning: Existing Starlette/httpx TestClient deprecation; no extra dependency added to suppress it

test_distinctions.deterministic: Unit tests, synthetic vectors, fake Embedder and HTTPX MockTransport; simulated failure and retry behavior
test_distinctions.real_database: Actual PostgreSQL vector codec, constraints, ownership, transactions, concurrent claims and migration roundtrips; DB faults/commit acknowledgement loss injected
test_distinctions.real_model: Actual pinned Ollama weights; all 74 chunks and one dev-02 query in final demo, not model training or generated medical answers
test_distinctions.full_regression: Actual Redis/RQ spawned worker and container acceptance also executed

review.correctness: Version, complete matching vectors, hashes, ascending distance, year filters, stable snapshot and atomic READY/parent completion
review.error_handling: Deadline, cancellation, retry counting, failed index with preserved chunks, late inputs/tokens, unknown COMMIT and explicit expired-run reconciliation
review.tests: Success, edge and failure cases executed; 66 targeted and complete real-dependency suite; skips separated
review.security: Owner filter both service and SQL, active users, parameter binding, safe errors, minimal runtime metadata permissions and ignored reports
review.maintainability: Generic persistence/index/retrieval separated from MedEvidence fixtures; one justified dependency; current API response shapes preserved

not_executed: Full 10-source embedding/seed and 30-case retrieval or answer evaluations
Medical refusal or supported-answer workflow at research endpoints
Manual failed-index retry or durable research-task retry accounting
Developer independent source/label and oral review
Remote CI verification at the time this pre-commit record was written
limitations: Indexing is explicit local invocation; queue still runs parsing only
Current preflight supports at most 128 chunks, reserving room for one request retry per batch; preflight rejection leaves PARSED/PENDING and must not be bypassed
Failed index attempts are terminal; expired RUNNING requires explicit invocation, no scheduler
Small-scale exact retrieval validates complete candidate vectors twice; scalability and overall research deadline not established
Synchronous SQL/file operations and cooperative cancellation are not hard real-time or hostile-input isolation
Client cancellation does not prove server inference has stopped; digest inventory checks are not atomic response provenance
One fixed developer query hitting page 5 is not corpus-wide Recall@5/MRR or medical quality validation
Day 8 human freeze and genuine-conflict gap remain pending
git_delivery: This evidence precedes commit/push. Verified Git history and the final chat message identify the commit, push and remote CI status.
